pool_efficiency.description: Pool efficiency comparison against the torpedo-shaped underwater glider baseline reported by the paper.

efficiency_gain_over_torpedo.description: Dimensionless hydrodynamic-efficiency gain over the torpedo reference under the same slice angles.

lift_to_drag.description: Raw lift-to-drag efficiency of the submitted cage shape.

energy_per_distance_relative.description: Relative work proxy, computed as inverse lift-to-drag, that penalizes inefficient glide distance.

trajectory_angle_deg.description: Predicted glide trajectory angle implied by lift-to-drag, where shallower trajectories are more efficient.

cage_feature_range_violation.description: Mean cage-parameter excursion outside the feature envelope of the base design library.

angle_sweep_efficiency.description: Optimized glider efficiency at the two fabricated operating angles emphasized by the paper.

efficiency_gain_over_torpedo.description: Dimensionless hydrodynamic-efficiency gain over the torpedo reference at each requested operating angle.

lift_to_drag.description: Raw lift-to-drag efficiency for the angle-specific submitted cage shape.

energy_per_distance_relative.description: Relative work proxy, computed as inverse lift-to-drag, for the angle-specific design.

trajectory_angle_deg.description: Predicted glide trajectory angle at the operating angle, where smaller is better.

cage_feature_range_violation.description: Mean cage-parameter excursion outside the feature envelope of the base design library.

surrogate_validation.description: Validation that the optimized design's predicted hydrodynamic efficiency agrees with independent physical/CFD-style evaluation.

lift_to_drag.description: Independent hydrodynamic lift-to-drag efficiency for the selected design.

surrogate_lift_to_drag.description: Method-side predicted lift-to-drag efficiency recorded in the design artifact.

surrogate_eta_abs_pct_error.description: Absolute percentage error between method-side predicted and independently rescored lift-to-drag.

raw_lift_to_drag.description: Unnormalized independent lift-to-drag value retained for diagnostics.

raw_surrogate_lift_to_drag.description: Unnormalized method-side surrogate lift-to-drag value retained for diagnostics.
